We are looking for a proactive, confidential and well-organised individual to provide administrative support to the Governance and Executive Support Lead, the Senior Leadership Team and Central Office colleagues. The post holder will support effective communication, meeting administration, office coordination and premises-related administration, helping Central Office run smoothly and professionally.

What You'll Be Doing
- Support the management of Central Office incoming calls, responding professionally and directing calls to the appropriate person or team.
- Deal efficiently and accurately with written and email requests for information, monitoring enquiry emails and ensuring they are responded to, actioned or forwarded as appropriate.
- Ensure visitors to Central Office are greeted professionally, sign in to the building, and are shown appropriate hospitality.

- Support the Governance and Executive Support Lead with the preparation, formatting, collation and circulation of papers, reports and correspondence, ensuring documents are accurate, professionally presented and shared in a timely manner.
- Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately when supporting senior leaders, trustees, colleagues, residents and external stakeholders.
- Prioritise day-to-day administrative tasks in discussion with the Governance and Executive Support Lead, escalating competing demands or urgent issues where needed.
- Maintain accurate administrative records, trackers and filing systems, ensuring information is stored securely and can be accessed by authorised colleagues when required.
- Distribute incoming post and deliveries, and ensure outgoing post is processed in line with Central Office arrangements.
